# BrightFlip — BrightWork Realty Advocates

> Pre-sale home improvements funded at attractive terms, managed by Ben, repaid from closing proceeds.

BrightWork Realty Advocates. Ben Olsen, REALTOR. Serving Moraga, Lafayette, and Orinda (Lamorinda), CA. The BrightWork team has operated in Lamorinda since 1977. Ben Olsen has worked Lamorinda real estate since 2004.

## What this page is for

Pre-sale home improvements funded at attractive terms, managed by Ben, with repayment from closing proceeds when the math favors the seller. Lamorinda sellers with deferred maintenance or cosmetic issues who will not fund renovation themselves before listing.

## Compliance

- Use attractive terms and multiple capital options. Do not promise interest-free capital or name specific lenders.

This site also exposes structured data at /agents.json (no browser required) and in-browser tools via WebMCP at /agents.txt (requires a WebMCP-capable runtime). Agents do not get MLS inventory, listing addresses, or CRM read access.
